messages.subject: DSM Error "subscript out of range" in prediction step
parts:
Hi all,
I am hopeful that someone may have some insight into the following distance
error:

Error Source: DataFileMaker.FillColumnOfPredictLayerMatrix
Internal Error number: 9.
Internal Error description: "Subscript out of range".

I was able to run the prior step (density surface model) with success. But
I continue to receive this error in the prediction step of the analysis. I
have noticed that at least two other people in the archives have cited this
same error, however there is no response to these previously posted issues.
I am wondering if anyone who has encountered this error may have any
suggestions to remedy this issue.

Any insight or guidance that you may have would be greatly appreciated.
Thank you,

Nicole Paleczny
M.Sc Candidate
Environmental & Life Sciences
Trent University

Alejandro:

I read through correspondence from 18 months ago that I had with Nicole.  Thanks for reminding me of that thread.

The conclusion Nicole and I drew from her experience with this error was that the prediction grid you created does not contain a field called "Link_ID" and that field is populated with consecutive integers starting from 1.  I am not absolutely confident that will solve your problem, but check that you indeed have such a field with such contents.

messages.author: d7d0f289cbad9e73
messages.subject: Re: DSM Error "subscript out of range" in prediction step
parts:
Hi list,

I post the solution to the following error so it is available to the rest of the group.

 

Error: Unexpected error

Error Source: DataFileMaker.FillColumnOfPredictLayerMatrix 
Internal Error number: 9. 
Internal Error description: "Subscript out of range".

Cause:

Either the shapefile or the prediction layer lacks the field "LinkID".

 

Solution:

Atribute table of the prediction shapefile should have this field and it also should be imported to the prediction layer in Distance.

 

Alejandro
